reports.title: Praxis Precision Medicines Provides Corporate Update and Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Loss of $3.23 a share, narrower than expected; two FDA decisions due in Dec and Jan
results: Praxis has no product sales yet; the net loss widened to $94.2m from $73.9m as it prepares for launches.
Loss per share was $3.23, smaller than a year ago ($3.36) because more shares are in issue after January's share sale.
Admin costs more than tripled to $42.7m on new staff and launch preparation; research spending was flat at $64.2m.
Cash and investments of about $1.3bn are expected to fund the company into 2028.

guidance.summary: Praxis gives no revenue or earnings guidance. It says its cash lasts into 2028 and lists key dates: FDA decisions on relutrigine (27 Dec 2026) and ulixacaltamide (29 Jan 2027).

watch: FDA decision on relutrigine for SCN2A and SCN8A epilepsies, due 27 Dec 2026.
FDA decision on ulixacaltamide for essential tremor, due 29 Jan 2027.
EMERALD study results in broader epilepsies (Q4 2026) and the Investor Day on 12 Nov.
